name: Member's Mark Organic Whole Frozen Strawberries (Smoothie Hack)
whyItWorks: Strawberries are lower in FODMAP fructose than apples and mangos. Blending ripe frozen strawberries into smoothies completely pulverizes the delicate outer achenes (seeds), allowing antioxidant absorption without gut friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Puree smooth with water or plant milk and pure maple syrup for a gentle morning vitamin C boost.
